Crystal Palace: Sean Dyche emerges as frontrunner for Eagles job if Pierre Sage leaves - Paper Talk
Plus: Crystal Palace are looking at potential options to replace Pierre Sage; Manchester United's hierarchy are in crisis talks over whether or not to sack Michael Carrick; Man Utd boss spoke with chief executive Omar Berrada and director of football Jason Wilcox after the Bournemouth loss
Sunday 25 October 2026 21:53, UK
The top stories and transfer rumours from Monday's newspapers...
CRYSTAL PALACE
Sean Dyche is a front-runner for the Crystal Palace job should the club part ways with Pierre Sage after Sunday's damaging 2-0 home defeat against Newcastle United - The Telegraph
Crystal Palace are looking at potential options to replace Pierre Sage as the team's manager - talkSPORT

MAN UTD
Dressing room insiders expect Michael Carrick to be sacked by Manchester United - talkSPORT
Michael Carrick is on the brink of being sacked as Manchester United manager - The Telegraph
Manchester United's hierarchy are in crisis talks over whether or not to sack Michael Carrick as head coach after he oversaw another torrid defeat against Bournemouth at Old Trafford on Sunday, that appeared to leave his job in the balance - The Guardian
Manchester United are yet to tell Michael Carrick whether he will be sacked after the feeble 3-0 home defeat to Bournemouth after Carrick spoke with chief executive Omar Berrada and director of football Jason Wilcox post-match - The Sun
SCOTTISH FOOTBALL
SFA chief Craig Mulholland is making changes to the youth development blueprint he pitched to clubs in a desperate bid to get it passed - The Scottish Sun

על פי דיווחים בתקשורת הבריטית, שון דייץ מוזכר כמועמד המוביל לקחת לידיו את תפקיד המאמן בקריסטל פלאס, זאת אם המועדון יחליט להיפרד מפייר סייג בעקבות תבוסה ביתית לניוקאסל יונייטד.

במקביל, הנהלת מנצ'סטר יונייטד נמצאת בשיחות חירום לגבי עתידו של המאמן מייקל קאריק לאחר הפסד ביתי צורב נוסף, הפעם לבורנמות. קאריק כבר הספיק לקיים שיחות עם המנכ
